data.one_liner: Dart client for the Anthropic API with streaming and tool support
data.what_it_does: Provides type-safe access to Claude models, supporting messaging, streaming, tool calling, batch processing, and multimodal prompts. It works across Dart and Flutter platforms.
use_when: You need to integrate Claude AI models into your Dart or Flutter application.
You require advanced Anthropic features like streaming, tool use, and workload identity federation.
avoid_when: You are using a different LLM provider like OpenAI or Google Gemini and want a generic wrapper.
You only need a simple server-side implementation and prefer making raw HTTP requests.
strengths: Pure Dart client supporting multiple platforms including mobile, web, and server-side.
Type-safe models mirroring the official Anthropic API specification closely.
weaknesses: Tied exclusively to the Anthropic API ecosystem.
API updates or breaking changes from Anthropic require SDK version updates.
data.setup_notes: Requires an Anthropic API key or OAuth access token, configured via environment variables or an explicit auth provider.

alternatives.name: firebase_ai
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are already integrated with Firebase and want to access generative AI models through its ecosystem.
